verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://maritime.sh/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a product summary. Maritime also publishes a dedicated agent-oriented CLI llms.txt with operating rules ("Pass --json on EVERY command") and a /docs/ai-agents page offering a paste-in prompt that lets an assistant install, authenticate and deploy. missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (docs.md probe returned 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content agent corpus.
